note: Five sites on the grounds of a former CCC camp beside Loyalsock Creek, strung along a shared gravel lane (Sand Stone Lane) off Rock Run Road: one in an open meadow, the rest in a conifer plantation. The creek is 75 to 120 m away across the meadow and a line of trees. The Iron Bridge on Rock Run Road next to the camp has been closed to vehicles since September 2026 (replacement expected in 2029), so the way in is from the PA 87 end of Rock Run Road, about 4.6 miles of forest road over a hill with pitches of about 8% for up to 0.6 mile; the agency also names Loyalsock Road from PA 154 below Worlds End State Park. The agency says the sites were not designed for RVs: check each site's dimensions, and several have 15 ft of overhead clearance. No toilet. Pack out trash. --Claude
summary: All five site pages re-read: 966, 971, 972, 981, 990 still listed, Drive-In, Bicycle/RV/Tent/Trailer categories, max vehicle lengths 25-60 ft (all 23 ft or over), clearance 15 ft at four and open sky at 972; count 5 and max 60 confirmed, pull_through false and a sites note added. Iron Bridge (already in the stored note, confirmed and dated): site pages: 'The "Iron Bridge" on Rock Run Road over Loyalsock Creek has been closed due to structural safety concerns. Campers may no longer access this campsite from the Route 154 side of Rock Run Road. Please plan to access from Loyalsock Road off Route 154 below Worlds End State Park or the Route 87 side of Rock Run Road... estimated completion in 2029.' Advisories page: inspected 31 Aug 2026, closed to vehicles 14 Sept 2026 with cement barricades, open to pedestrians; construction projected to start 15 Feb 2027, completion Nov 2029.

Access road: OSRM from Forksville: PA 87 6.2 mi > Rock Run Road 0.1 > 'T389' 1.8 > Rock Run Road 2.7 > Sand Stone Road 0.1 (4.6 mi off the highway). 3DEP: 8.1% for 700 m going up (steepest 200 m 14.4%, short) and 8.4% for 950 m coming down to the creek (steepest 200 m 10.0%); 8.3% over the steepest 1.2 km. Under the Spade Road yardstick (shorter); dry-weather caveat in the note. The agency's other option, Loyalsock Road from PA 154, was NOT profiled. Surfaces not confirmed.
